scope: Six hosted C17 profiles, actual k2 merging and two-level recompression, independent centroid/mixture/raw-rank checks and explicit merge-order/large-error/rounding divergences. No universal accuracy or physical claim.
limitations: Scope hashes bind this campaign. Whole-curriculum input identity and current publication must be bound separately before edition acceptance.
A finite passing test suite does not prove arbitrary inputs or learner mastery.

reference_arithmetic_example.meaning: Different rounding paths can order nearly equal stored means differently, changing later greedy groups. This comparison is an investigation, not a failed exact cross-arithmetic contract.

independent_oracles.rank_error_definition: distance from requested q to exact empirical [strict-less,less-or-equal] rank interval at returned value
independent_oracles.limits: These are observed finite errors, not a worst-case error theorem or unbiasedness claim. Centroid invariant checks do not recover lost samples. Complete independent construction equality is asserted for fresh batches; different-rounding history divergence is retained explicitly.
